A watercolor sketch of this home’s front entrance — the black door marked “5,” the tree, the potted plants, the climbing vines. Placed in the entryway so guests arrive to find a portrait of the very place they’re staying.

Kaitlen Yoo is a Los Angeles-based artist who works en plein air across the city, capturing the architecture and atmosphere of West LA neighborhoods in watercolor and ink.
